headline: TEX @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 4.00 at BOS 4.05, with a projected total of 8.05. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: TEX moved +0.21 runs while BOS moved +0.45, changing the projected margin by -0.23 runs. The projected total climbed +0.66, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Connelly Early has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ceddanne Rafaela, Josh Jung, Willson Contreras, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nate Eaton, Justin Foscue because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
